lines.text: *Yawn* Have you ever seen a polar bear before? If not, forget I asked.
No matter how much I sleep, I'm always a little bit tired.
Can I rest my eyes for a little bit?
Why don't we go looking for polar bears together?
All I want to do is give you a big bear hug and go to sleep... Oh, you won't break or anything, will you?
Oh Burly Bear, you're so warm and cuddly.
Where'd you go? I'm struggling to stay awake here...
You didn't go looking for polar bears without me, did you?
Where can you find polar bears? Perhaps... there aren't any here?
*Yaaawn* Can you help me find somewhere I can sleep?
I was just about to fall asleep, but then I remembered something.
So sleepy... Let me know if you see a polar bear.
I feel like I've gotten stronger but... I'm still sleepy.
Falling asleep...
If I want to catch a glimpse of a polar bear, I've got to keep at it.
Wowee, is that a polar bear plushie?! Oh, it's not... Well, it's still really nice.
Thanks, Burly Bear.
Just for you, I'll find a polar bear so you can get a good look at one.

Whenever I'm around you, it's like my fatigue just melts away...
Was it that obvious I was lying?
Could I maybe... sleep beside you?
You're the first thing I've ever liked more than polar bears.
Off to find some polar bears!
Did you call me?
Should we go?
*Yawn* I'm ready.
After this battle, I'll go search for a polar bear.
You'll need to wake me up if I zonk out.
Think we should scrounge around for what polar bears eat?
Reloading!
Relax, what's the rush?
... I almost fell asleep.
Watch this, Burly Bear.
Polar Bear Power!
*Yawwwwn*
Gotcha!
This is easy.
*Yawn* I'm feeling a little foggy.
Ugh.
Argh!
Ah.
So tired... I'm going to go to sleep now.
If we wanna see any polar bears, we should get a move on.
